notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #8: Heads-Up! Indicators & Emotions
notes.content:
Hey, Café Managers! 👋
In today’s devlog, we’re taking a look above our guests' heads - literally!
We’re introducing dynamic indicators above NPCs to help you better manage orders, guest moods, and the overall café flow.

Here’s what’s new! 👇

💬 What Do They Want?
No more guessing - the indicator above an NPC’s head clearly shows what they’re looking for:
[list]
[*] 🧁 Product icons: Coffee, tea, pastries - you’ll see from a distance exactly what each guest wants.
[*] 💡 Recommendations: If a guest doesn’t know what to order, a speech bubble with “What do you recommend today?” will pop up - your chance to impress with something special!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/6b6b37e597dafba89a36a4cedba5329a6cfab5d4.png[/img]
😠 Mood Levels – New Emotion System
Guests are waiting… but for how long?
[list]
[*] 😐 Green indicator: All good - the guest is feeling fine.
[*] 😟 Yellow indicator: Uh-oh, waiting a bit too long…
[*] 😡 Red indicator: Warning! The guest is getting frustrated - ignore them too long and they might storm out!
Each emotion level updates in real time with animated transitions, so you can act fast and keep the vibe friendly.
[/list]
📱 Guest Comments in Speech Bubbles
Some characters have a little more to say:
[list]
[*] 💬 Thoughtful quotes: “It smells amazing in here!” / “Just a quick stop - please be fast!” / “This is my favorite café!”
[*] These little moments help bring your guests to life and add flavor to your café’s atmosphere.
[*] Some guests won’t just order what’s on the menu - they might wish for something special they’ve seen elsewhere.
“Do you happen to have matcha latte today?”
If you don’t… maybe it’s time to rush and unlock that new license! 🙂
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/5509925e0e5c1225cd7415b8442897724917b1a6.png[/img]
With these new indicators, gameplay becomes more intuitive and engaging - you’ll always know who needs what, and how they’re feeling.

What other useful indicators would you like to see above your guests’ heads?
How about a signal that someone is just browsing and not ready to order yet? Or maybe a badge showing VIP customers who expect top-tier service? Let us know what kind of info would help you manage your café-shop more efficiently!

👉 Let us know!

notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #7: Café Chitchat - NPC Interactions!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In today's devlog, we want to give you a closer look at how we're bringing the world of My Café Manager Simulator to life through interactions with our guests! 
See what's new for you! 👇

☀️ Meetups and Conversations at the Café

Your guests love spending time in the cozy atmosphere of your café, both indoors and outdoors!
Outdoor Tables: When the weather is nice, NPCs will sit at the outdoor tables, enjoying the fresh air and having conversations.
Comfy Indoor Sofas: Inside the café, guests will relax on the sofas, chatting with each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/684063857664c62097ce1cd5ca6493b4c148311f.png[/img]

☕ Personal Orders and Returning Customers

Every guest interaction is unique!
[list]
[*] "What do you recommend today?": Some NPCs will ask you for a recommendation of the day with a speech bubble as they enter. Prepare something special for them!
[*] "Hey, it's me again! That latte was delicious, I'll have another one!": Returning guests will remember your best drinks and will happily order them again.
[*] "I had to bring the crew! We'll take 3 espressos and 2 lattes, I've been telling them all about it!": Sometimes your regulars will bring their friends along, ready to try your specialties. 
[/list]
We hope these interactions will make your café an even more lively and engaging place! What other spontaneous guest behaviors would you like to see in the game?

notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 👋
We are excited to present the first version of the We've been working hard to create an immersive experience where you can manage your café, serve customers and grow your business. Here's what we've accomplished recently!

🍽️ [b]Menu Development[/b]
We've added a system that lets you fully customize your menus! 🎨
Decide which items to include, set their prices, and manage your offerings exactly the way you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/a648a21213287876f7abde830e404a3cc6fad84c.gif[/img]

💳 [b]Payment Options[/b]
[list]
[*] Payment by card: If paying by card, enter the amount into the payment terminal.
[*] Cash payment: For cash payment, you will have to give change by selecting the exact amount of cash from a pool of available banknotes.
[*] Customer feedback: When the coffee is served and the payment is completed, Payment successful will appear on your computer screen which shows that you did a great job! 😊
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/e1f8ffc57cbeb5ac82f0321a3fe6e73a6e373d90.gif[/img]

🛒 [b]Restocking Supplies[/b]
Running out of products: When you run out of products, use your laptop to place an order for fresh ingredients and they will be delivered straight to your café!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/3ff4d7543ec10bbe0db526fb849788153d7c8656.gif[/img]

🛍️ [b]Serving Customers[/b]
[list]
[*] Displaying Merchandise: Showcase your products on shelves for customers to browse and choose from.
[*] Selling Goods: Once they’ve made a selection, you can sell the goods to your customers.
[*] Preparing Coffee: Of course, don't forget to prepare delicious coffee for them to enjoy! ☕
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288198/5ff522bf852e4e1b1856e5c606f862edf205a330.gif[/img]

[b]Let’s Talk![/b]
We’re still in the early stages and would love to hear from you what you think about these features so far? Are there specific elements you’d like us to focus on or ideas you’d love to see in the game?
